verdict.rationale: No OpenAPI or Swagger spec could be found: every standard candidate path returned 404, and the markdown docs path also 404s. The closest substitutes are the LLM-oriented text docs (llms.txt / llms-full.txt) and a zero-setup `/mock` mirror of every real path that shows each endpoint's exact response shape. Those are machine-friendly, but they are not a downloadable formal spec. Missing for 10: a published, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) document, formal request/response schemas, and independent confirmation that such a spec exists.
